cards.card_text: Jesus answered, "If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water." I bet she's thinking, living WHAT now?
cards.verse_text: Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”

cards.card_text: The woman points out a problem with Jesus getting this living water.
cards.verse_text: “Sir,” the woman replied, “You have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where then will You get this living water?

cards.card_text: Come see a man who told me everything I ever did Come see a prophet who gave me living water Come see a teacher sitting by the old well
cards.verse_text: “Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Christ?”
